classification: Opt-in signed Decision Input assessments, V3 transaction risk, and PriorSeal swap authorization
receiptImpact: Existing OracleSafetyCheck and ExecutionReceipt layouts, registry release, attester keys, partner policies, and activation set v6 remain unchanged. Insight SDK adds the separately versioned signed DecisionInputAssessment schema, independent source and destination verification, unsigned local V3 transaction-risk evidence, and an opt-in PriorSeal-bound swap path. The SDK change does not alter any partner policy or partner production verifier admission.
activationRule: Consumers must explicitly supply DecisionInputTrust and signed source and destination assessments and call the strict V3 PriorSeal flow. That flow checks the exact V3 call and router, requires PriorSeal authorization and durable execution gating, and returns advisory service-response evidence. Existing SDK calls remain opt-in compatible. This promotion does not change partner activations, grant partner reliance, authorize live execution without the configured PriorSeal path, or publish an npm package. The local drill uses an isolated EVM and valueless test tokens.
